name: C13 — Bypass FTS-index rebuild in tests that don't query FTS
description: Added a keyword-only rebuild_fts flag (default true) to SearchPipeline.ingest_directory that skips the FTS optimize/rebuild block, new unit tests for it, and switched eligible ingest tests to opt out to cut xdist wall time.
effort: Small production change: one parameter and one guard in a single method, no storage or migrations. Bulk is a mechanical per-test audit of two test files plus a stability and coverage measurement gate. Main risk is silent misclassification of tests that still query search.
